title: EFTEM Reimagined: Bridging Legacy Methods with Machine Learning for Advanced Materials Analysis
content: The integration of machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) has revolutionized materials science, providing more precise and scalable insights into material properties and behavior [1,2]. Electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS) and energy-filtered transmission electron microscopy (EFTEM), powerful tools for spatially resolved chemical and morphological characterization, have greatly benefited from these advancements. By combining EFTEM with ML, researchers can uncover deeper insights into material systems, particularly at the nanoscale, such as grain boundaries.
